notes: ACS multi-agent-hotload adopter state. Live join/continue order wins; the seed list is a hint only. PCM, CGM, OIO and ACS all come from one commit of Pukujan/agent-stack-train (2e32f2c, stack 1.0.1): PCM CLI 0.7.0, CGM 0.5.13 with all eight modules, OIO 0.3.0, and the multi-agent-hotload module 0.1.0. stack-manifest.json follows release train `current`. Boss lease is minutes (default 30, range 15-120); the watchdog is agent-less and liveness-only. The decision-boss seat is vacant until the first live continuer claims it.

role_fill.notes: First live continuer with a valid lease is decision boss; later continuers fill coder or worker seats. Tool identity does not assign roles.

agents.notes: Seed hint for an empty room; live join/continue order wins when filling vacant seats.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron/Action/script only. No LLM. No peer agent. Watchdog != failover. ~10m liveness/nudge only.

acs.notes: ACS multi-agent-hotload 0.1.0, from the acs/ folder of the one agent-stack-train checkout. The revision is the agent-stack-train commit it was installed from.

pcm.notes: Full PCM for adopters: continuity/checkpoints plus PR-only, required CI gates, protection/auto-merge preference, fail-closed gates, leaf/parent receipts. The revision is the agent-stack-train commit it was installed from. Do not vendor PCM source.

routing.readme_product_entry: writing-direction (MUST load; scan-first selective bold; do not apply HSW bold restraints)
routing.pr_issue_docs_commits: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST load for PR/issue titles+bodies, docs, commits)
routing.html_reports_compare_appendable: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST; default ON; no per-report opt-in)
routing.contract: docs/writing-routing.json + docs/ACS_VERIFY.md; application=must_load; acs_prompt_inject after VALID

cgm.notes: FULL CGM required for ACS and every hotloader adopter: all eight modules including human-output-naming. The revision is the agent-stack-train commit it was installed from. Validate with CGM's validate_content_system.py; then apply acs_prompt_inject. Do not vendor CGM source.

oio.notes: OIO 0.3.0 issue-log ontology, form and triage, plus the close-on-merge and close-sweep workflows, from the oio/ folder of the one agent-stack-train checkout. The revision is the agent-stack-train commit it was installed from. OIO's installer needs descriptor-relative no-follow filesystem calls that Windows lacks, so it runs in CI (Linux) and refuses on Windows by design.

ticket_links.notes: Parent/child notes only; no full DAG engine.
